episodes.title: What is Public Health?
episodes.description: Well, public health is an approach to preventing disease, prolonging life, and promoting health for literally everyone.

episodes.title: How Your Biology Affects Your Health
episodes.description: Explore how biological determinants, including age, genes, and sex, influence health.

episodes.title: How the Environment Affects Your Health
episodes.description: Examine the influence of environmental conditions on health.

episodes.title: How Society Affects Your Health
episodes.description: Explore how social systems, sanitation, and access to nutritious food shape health.

episodes.title: Stress is Bad for Your Health
episodes.description: Examine the different ways stress influences health.

episodes.title: Intro to Epidemiology
episodes.description: Explore approaches to conducting epidemiological research.

episodes.title: Which Healthcare System is Best?
episodes.description: Compare the different ways countries organize and provide healthcare.

episodes.title: Health and Policy
episodes.description: Explore how public policies, from seatbelt requirements to land-use rules, influence health even when they are not labeled health policies.

episodes.title: Global Health
episodes.description: Examine public health challenges and successes across the world.

episodes.title: The Future of Public Health
episodes.description: Consider possible futures for public health using plans and approaches already being developed.
